$comment: The test tenants and users every provider Terraform root that seeds a provider builds (infra/keycloak, infra/zitadel), and the tests read. See infra/fixtures/README.md.

tenants: canonical is true when a canonical tenant names the tenant; descope is the Descope tenant (infra/tenants.tf) it maps to, ory is null because the Ory project has no organizations (infra/ory/main.tf).

users: a user's email is <key>@<domain of home>; home is the tenant the user lives in (a Zitadel user's organization). roles maps each tenant the user is a member of to the user's canonical role there, or null for a member with no grant.
cases: the user each case of the suites stands on.
